content: A bridge on Ethereum lost $5M in a single transaction after an operator key was compromised.

metadata.title: Bridge loses $5M in a single transaction

content: The team paused withdrawals within an hour and confirmed the loss in a status update.
A post mortem published the next day attributes the drain to a leaked deployer key.

metadata.title: Post mortem attributes drain to leaked deployer key

content: Users reported failed withdrawals for roughly two hours before the pause landed.
